question: We want to trade with the Snow Time Lakers (Kyle Booth's team). The plan: offer Kyle a 2-for-1 (we send two players, we receive one), and Kyle drops Cedric Coward, his worst player, to make room. What is the best trade to offer? Answer as 'Send A + B, get C'.
research_note: Wire was benched for this meeting at the user's request. Each member had WebSearch/WebFetch and did its own web research (run as a general-purpose agent loading its .claude/agents/council-<id>.md persona). Both rosters came from a live ESPN sync (council/espn_sync.py) at 05:16 UTC.

ballots.vote: Send Desmond Bane + Caleb Wilson, get Donovan Clingan
ballots.rationale: A 2-for-1 is near zero-sum in true points, so the edge has to come from where ESPN's projections, which Kyle sees, misprice our scoring. Clingan is the biggest such gap: 41.04 FP/g over 77 GP actual against a 33.84 ESPN projection (blind spot 5.95). Bane (36.85 actual vs 38.26 projected, ADP 49.8) and Wilson (rookie, projected 34.88, our second-weakest by council vote) look better to Kyle than they are to us. With a lineup optimizer and a ~34 FA refill, we gain +4.1 FP/g across our starting ten while Kyle sees +2.6. No star target (Johnson, Tatum, Embiid, Kyrie) nets us anything above zero on terms Kyle would accept.

ballots.vote: Send Jamal Murray + Desmond Bane, get Jalen Johnson
ballots.rationale: Jalen Johnson is the only full-sample elite line on Kyle's roster (53.08 FP/g, 72 GP, +3.125 bonus/g); Tatum and Kessler are THIN and Irving and Dybantsa are NO_SAMPLE. Murray (47.8, 75 GP) + Bane (36.86, 82 GP) lifts our top-10 sum by +3.85 FP/g, keeps both our centers, opens a waiver slot, and ADP 32.6 + 49.8 for 8.7 is a believable price. Under the real limit of at most 4 C, Kyle cannot take both Duren and Okongwu, since he already has 3 C.

ballots.vote: Send Kawhi Leonard + Desmond Bane, get Jalen Johnson
ballots.rationale: Johnson is Kyle's best per-game player with a real sample: FP_ACT_PG 53.08 over 72 GP, projection 50.0-54.5 including a 4.5 blind spot. Kawhi plus Bane cost 86.9 actual and 86.6 projected FP/g; the freed spot streams at 33-37 FP/g against Coward's 28.1, so we net about 0 to +4 per game and roughly +500 to +600 points over the season. Kyle stays at 3 centres under the 4-centre limit, and the pair is the strongest offer by market price (ADP 30.5 and 49.8).

ballots.vote: Send Caleb Wilson + Paul George, get Donovan Clingan
ballots.rationale: Clingan's 41.04 FP/g over 77 GP is worth about 2,996 points (P_GP 73). Adding a free agent at about 34 FP/g to the open spot brings in about 2,380 more, against about 4,455 from Wilson (34.88 projected × 71) and George (35.96 × 55): roughly +920 for us, or +1,400 if Wilson's 22.4 FP/g preseason holds. By ADP Kyle gets 76.6 + 105.0 for 81.8 + Coward's 127.8, an upgrade on both pieces, and he gives up a centre from his three-centre surplus. Clingan's RANK_GAP of +24 (ADP rank 61, league-scored rank 37) is what we are exploiting.

ballots.vote: Send Kawhi Leonard + Dejounte Murray, get Jalen Johnson
ballots.rationale: Johnson is the most bankable star on Kyle's roster: 53.08 FP/g over 72 GP, projected 72 GP, full go for the opener with two preseason double-doubles. We sell our two biggest games risks: Kawhi (load-management plan, rests on back-to-backs, CSV DAY_TO_DAY) and Dejounte (14 GP last year, toe contusion). Discounted for games missed, plus a ~33 FP/g free agent in the open spot, we gain about +800 FP for the season, and Kyle loses only about 340, which we can sell as depth for his injury-heavy roster. It sends no centres, so it cannot break the 4-C limit (positionLimits key 5) for Kyle, who already has 3.

ballots.vote: Send Caleb Wilson + Paul George, get Walker Kessler
ballots.rationale: Kessler has a locked starting role (Redick named him a starter, 4yr/$130M), is fully cleared and projects 31.4 min, with a 5.80 FP/g OREB/BLK blind spot that ESPN cannot see, so Kyle undervalues him (38.61 on his screen vs about 44.4 for us). Wilson (0 NBA games, 34.88 projected) and George (35.96 over 37 games, age 36) are both near the 34 FP/g free-agent level, so with the freed spot we gain about +7.6 FP/g while Kyle's ESPN screen shows him +5.0, which makes the offer one he is likely to accept. If the C cap is read correctly (positionLimits '5' = C, max 4), Kyle cannot take both Duren and Okongwu, and this deal keeps both rosters legal (ours 3 C, his 2 C).

ballots.vote: Send Dejounte Murray + Caleb Wilson, get Joel Embiid
ballots.rationale: The raw positionLimits key 5 is default position C (espn-api uses defaultPositionId-1), so the cap is max 4 centres, not 4 guards. Kyle holds 3 C and we hold 2, so this deal leaves him at 2 and us at 3, both legal, and his drop of Coward keeps him at 13. Embiid (46.40 FP/g, 38 GP) takes our 10th starter slot from Dejounte's 36.49, about +9.9 FP/g. The freed spot refills from waivers at about 35 FP/g (Nembhard 35.17), so Wilson (34.88 proj) costs us almost nothing.

ballots.vote: Send Jamal Murray + Dejounte Murray, get Jalen Johnson
ballots.rationale: Jalen Johnson is the only Snow Time target whose number survives the A_GP check: 53.08 FP/g over 72 GP, healthy, two preseason double-doubles. Tatum (16 GP), Kessler (5 GP), Embiid (38 GP, DTD) and Kyrie/Dybantsa (no sample) do not. Packaging Dejounte Murray (36.49 on a THIN 14 GP, toe contusion all preseason) with Jamal Murray (47.8, 75 GP) adds about 4.8 FP per starting slot, frees a spot for streaming (Nurkic 36.8, Nembhard 35.2), and gives Kyle 84.3 FP/g against the 81.2 he loses (Johnson 53.1 + Coward 28.1), so it reads as fair to him. It also respects the real roster cap: rosterSettings.positionLimits '5':4 means a 4-C maximum, not the 4-G limit league-rules.md says, so no two-C package to a 3-C team works.

ballots.vote: Send Dejounte Murray + Caleb Wilson, get Donovan Clingan
ballots.rationale: This executes the council's own record: Wilson (15/19) and Dejounte Murray (12/19 runoff) are our two remaining voted-weakest players, and Clingan was third on our pick-54 board, taken one pick before us. Clingan's 41.04 FP/g over 77 GP plus a ~33 waiver add (Wiggins 33.78) beats Dejounte's 36.49 over 14 GP plus Wilson's 34.88 NO_SAMPLE projection by +2.7 to +7.5 FP/g. Kyle gains on ADP (68.6 + 76.6 for 81.8), both incoming players outrank Coward (ADP 127.8, 28.12) so he still drops Coward, and the C cap (positionLimits '5': 4) holds at 3 C for us and 2 for Kyle.
